review_description: Salesman explained solar in laymans terms, was punctual and not too much pressure. Price was very competitive.

I opted for a 2.1 Kw (12x175w panels) with a 3.6 Kw inverter to enable expansion of the system at a later date.I would like to thank  you Finn for supplying me with links to someone in the Bendigo area who could advise me on my solar energy needs.The service provided by Russell Broad Electrical included all the paperwork to do with rebates etc. all I had to do was decide on a convenient time for the installation and pay $9485 labour and materiels.
